PEJ applies for early works permit for nuclear power plant
articles.원문 요약: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has applied to the head of the Pomeranian Voivodeship for a permit to start early works required for the construction of Poland's first nuclear power plant at the Lubiatowo-Kopalino site in the Choczewo municipality.

articles.제목: First concrete poured for unit 5 at Haiyang plant
articles.원문 요약: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 5 at the Haiyang nuclear power plant. It is the fifth of six large pressurised water reactors planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

articles.제목: Texas SMR plant moves to final permitting stage
articles.원문 요약: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission says there will soon be a construction permit announcement after it finished its safety review for the Xe-100 reactor, which is proposed for deployment at the Long Mott Generating Station in Texas.

articles.제목: Next-generation fuel projects get US federal funding
articles.원문 요약: Eight nuclear fuel technology projects have been selected to receive a share of up to USD50 million of federal funding under a US Department of Energy programme to support R&D to deliver TRU fuel technologies.

articles.제목: Uganda and Russia look to move ahead with nuclear project
articles.원문 요약: A roadmap setting out cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy, as part of work towards a nuclear power plant, has been signed by Russia and Uganda.
